scheme_name: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a ward of an unemployed ex‑serviceman or a ward of the widow of an ex‑serviceman
Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Ward must be studying in a government‑recognized institution
Scheme is applicable for up to two wards per ex‑serviceman or widow
Application must be submitted offline within three months from the date of completion of education
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of tuition fees up to the listed rates (₹1,000–₹2,000) or the actual cost, whichever is lower.
